source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶2.4 footnote 3 and ¶4.9.15; FAQ applicable to all MSOs, Q17
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第2.4段附註3及第4.9.15段；適用於所有金錢服務經營者的常見問題第17問

en.q: Which of the following are correct about international organisations and sources of information used in assessing ML/TF risk?
statements: Credible sources are information produced by reputable, universally recognised international organisations and other bodies that make it publicly and widely available.
Beyond the named international bodies, the examples of credible sources include relevant national government bodies, while excluding non-government organisations.
For PEP identification, an international organisation is established through formal political agreements between its member States that have the status of international treaties.
A customer’s connection to a jurisdiction listed in the FATF statement on improving global AML/CFT compliance through the On-going Process does not make EDD mandatory.
notes: True: ¶2.4 footnote 3 defines the term through the standing of the producing bodies and the public, wide availability of their information.
False: ¶2.4 footnote 3 expressly includes “relevant national government bodies and non-government organisations”.
True: ¶4.9.15 includes this establishment criterion. Legal recognition in the member countries and non-resident institutional status are further criteria.
True: FAQ Q17 says EDD is “not mandatory” for this list, while the connection should be considered in determining the overall customer risk profile.

tc.q: 關於國際組織及評估洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險所用的資料來源，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 可靠消息來源是由有良好聲譽和廣為人知的國際組織及其他組織所提供、並廣泛流傳的資訊。
除具名的國際組織外，可靠消息來源的例子亦包括有關的政府組織，但並不包括非政府機構所提供的資訊。
就識別政治人物而言，國際組織的成立依據，是成員國之間具有國際條約地位的正式政治協議。
客戶與特別組織「持續進展」聲明所列司法管轄區有關連，並不令更嚴格盡職審查措施成為強制性規定。
notes: 正確：第2.4段附註3以組織的「良好聲譽和廣為人知」及資訊「廣泛流傳」界定可靠消息來源。
錯誤：第2.4段附註3明列「有關的政府組織和非政府機構」，排除非政府機構收窄了來源範圍。
正確：第4.9.15段明列這項成立條件；另外還須獲成員國法律認可，及不被視作所在地的常駐機構單位。
正確：常見問題第17問說更嚴格盡職審查措施「並非強制性規定」，但釐定整體風險狀況時應顧及有關連繫。

en.text: “Credible sources” refers to information that is produced by reputable and universally recognised international organisations and other bodies that make such information publicly and widely available.
as well as relevant national government bodies and non-government organisations.
International organisations referred to in paragraph [4.9.14] are entities established by formal political agreements between their member States that have the status of international treaties;

conducting EDD is not mandatory for customers connected to jurisdictions listed in the FATF statement: “Improving Global Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (“AML/CFT”) Compliance: On-going Process”.

tc.text: 「可靠消息來源」是指由一些有良好聲譽和廣為人知的國際組織及其他組織所提供及廣泛流傳 的資訊。
以及有關的政府組織和非政府機構。
第[4.9.14]段所指的國際組織指由成員國根據具有國際條約地位 的正式政治協議成立的實體；
對與題為“改善全球打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的合規情況：持續進展”的特別組織聲明所列司法管轄區有關連的客戶採取更嚴格盡職審查措施並非強制性規定。

en.q: An MSO’s compliance briefing summarises how Hong Kong counters proliferation financing. According to C&ED’s circular on identification and mitigation of proliferation financing risks, which statements are correct?
statements: The counter-proliferation financing regime relies on UNSO regulations that apply to every sanctioned country alike.
Under the WMD(CPS)O, lending money is treated as a financial transaction outside the services the Ordinance controls.
The WMD(CPS)O offence requires the person to know for certain that the services will assist WMD activities.
A genuine hit on a designated person found in transaction monitoring may be reported to the JFIU with the next periodic return.
notes: Incorrect: the PF circular says the counter-PF regime is implemented through legislation including the regulations under the UNSO that are specific to the DPRK and Iran, and the WMD(CPS)O.
Incorrect: the PF circular says the provision of services under the WMD(CPS)O is widely defined and includes the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance.
Incorrect: section 4 of the WMD(CPS)O prohibits providing services where the person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that they may be connected to PF; certainty is not required.

Incorrect: the PF circular requires suspicious transaction reports to the JFIU as soon as practicable for genuine designated-person hits found in monitoring; it does not allow holding them for the next periodic return.

tc.q: 某金錢服務經營者的合規簡報概述香港如何打擊擴散融資。根據海關有關識別和緩解擴散融資風險的通函，下列哪些陳述正確？
statements: 打擊擴散融資制度依靠一套同樣適用於所有受制裁國家的《聯合國制裁條例》規例。
《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》所管制的服務，把借出款項排除在外。
《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》的罪行，須以確知有關服務會協助大規模毀滅武器活動為條件。
交易監察發現與指明人士真正吻合時，可疑交易報告可留待下次定期申報才提交聯合財富情報組。
notes: 不正確：擴散融資通函指出，打擊擴散融資制度透過法例實施，包括根據《聯合國制裁條例》針對朝鮮及伊朗訂立的規例，以及《大規模毀滅武器(提供服務的管制)條例》。
不正確：擴散融資通函指出，提供服務被廣泛界定為及包括借出款項或以其他方式提供金融資助。
不正確：該條例第4條禁止提供任何基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散融資有關的服務，並非以確知為條件。
不正確：擴散融資通函要求在監察中發現與指明人士真正吻合者，須盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告，並不容許留待下次定期申報才提交。

en.text: including the regulations made under the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance which are specific to the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea and Iran
The provision of services is widely defined and includes the lending of money or other provision of financial assistance.
Section 4 of WMD(CPS)O prohibits a person from providing any services where he believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that those services may be connected to PF.

file suspicious transaction reports with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (“JFIU”) as soon as practicable for any genuine hits of designated persons or entities on the United Nations Sanction Lists during transaction monitoring

tc.text: 包括根據《聯合國制裁條例》針對朝鮮及伊朗訂立的規例及《大規模毀滅武器(提供服務的管制)條例》
提供服務被廣泛界定為及包括借出款項或以其他方式提供金融資助
第4條禁止任何人提供任何基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散融資有關的服務
盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告
